verdict: PDD grew revenue 8% to $16.6B and operating profit 8% too, but a $1.1B other loss and higher taxes cut net income 12% to $4.0B.

kpis.label: EPS (diluted, per ADS)
kpis.note: RMB18.45 per ADS, vs RMB20.75 a year ago; 1 ADS = 4 ordinary shares

kpis.label: Cash & short-term investments
kpis.note: RMB456.4B at June 30, plus $14.2B of time deposits and debt securities in other non-current assets

segments.name: Online marketing services and others
segments.note: Ads and marketing services merchants buy on Pinduoduo and Temu. Up 3% in RMB (RMB57.6B).

segments.name: Transaction services
segments.note: Fees PDD earns for completing sales on its platforms, including payment and delivery support. Up 13% in RMB (RMB54.7B) — the growth engine this quarter.

opex.name: Sales and marketing
opex.note: Promoting Pinduoduo and Temu and winning shoppers and merchants. Up 9% in RMB.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Engineers and product work. Up 27% in RMB.

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: Running the company — finance, legal and admin. Up 53% in RMB.

otherDetail: Interest and investment income was $1,990M, less an $82M foreign-exchange loss and a $1,090M other loss, for net other income of $818M; the share of results of equity investees was a further $6M loss.

takeaways.title: Growth, led by transaction fees
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 8% to $16.6B. Transaction services — the fees on completed sales — grew 13% to $8.1B, while online marketing services grew just 3% to $8.5B. Operating profit also rose 8%, to $4.1B, as the company spent more on helping merchants and on trust and safety.

takeaways.title: A big other loss hit the bottom line
takeaways.text: Below the operating line, 'other income' swung to a $1,090M loss from a small gain a year ago, overwhelming $1,990M of interest and investment income. With taxes also higher at $898M, net income fell 12% to $4.0B even though the core business earned more.

takeaways.title: The cash pile keeps growing
takeaways.text: Operations generated $3.8B of cash in the quarter, and cash plus short-term investments reached $67.3B — with another $14.2B in time deposits and debt securities on top. Diluted earnings per ADS were $2.72, down from the equivalent of about $3.06 a year ago.

oneTimers: Other income swung to a $1,090M loss (from a $119M gain in RMB terms a year ago) — the release does not break out the cause, and it is the main reason net income fell while operating profit rose.
On the company's non-GAAP basis, which adds back share-based pay, operating profit was $4.3B and net income $4.2B.
footerNote: PDD reports in RMB; every figure here is the release's own US$ convenience translation at RMB6.7851 = US$1.00, the noon buying rate on June 30, 2026.

sources.label: Official earnings release, Form 6-K Exhibit 99.1 (SEC EDGAR)
